cache-images-count.why: Sanity check on the cache and a record of its header.

uitouch-ivars.why: Phase 6 click-to-tap preference 2 needs to set a synthesized UITouch's location, window, view and phase. Those are private ivars, so their presence and names on tvOS 27.2 must come from the device itself before any code touches them.

uitouch-class.why: The UITouch class declaration as the device actually has it, including ivar layout.

uievent-class.why: Synthesizing a touch needs a UIEvent to carry it; same private-ivar question.

gcmicrogamepad-class.why: Confirm the Siri Remote's micro gamepad profile exists on the device, not just in the SDK.

gceventviewcontroller-class.why: Confirm the focus-engine bypass class exists on the device.

uidatepicker-class.why: Phase 1 flagged UIDatePicker (RBBirthdayPickerController.nib) as the class most likely missing on tvOS. This asks the device directly.

metal-newlibrarywithdata.why: Phase 1's biggest launch risk: whether tvOS Metal accepts Roblox's iOS-compiled metallib blobs. Looks for the loader entry point in the device's Metal.

coreui-deployment-platform.why: Phase 1: whether the device's CoreUI refuses an asset catalog whose deploymentPlatform is ios.

dyld-version.why: Evidence source 5: match Apple's open-source dyld to the version this device ships.

objc-version.why: Evidence source 5: match Apple's open-source objc4 to the version this device ships.
